item.title: Harmeet Dhillon, DOJ's controversial civil rights chief, resigns
item.description: Harmeet Dhillon, the assistant attorney general for the Civil Rights Division, resigned from the Justice Department on Thursday.

item.title: Dow plunges nearly 1,700 points, wiping out gains from midterm results stock rally
item.description: The selloff came a day after the Dow soared more than 1,500 points.

item.title: Voter frustration about the economy went beyond gas prices, Voter Poll shows
item.description: Three-fours of voters described the economy as not good or poor, polls showed.

item.title: Democrats prepare to take Congress as GOP grapples with stunning losses
item.description: After Democrats' sweeping House and Senate victories, the party is laying out how it plans to wield power, while President Trump and Republicans react...
